plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for GE MDS Orbit industrial routers (MDS-SYSTEM-MIB, enterprise PEN 4130). It reports uptime, system temperature, power supply voltage, MPR heatsink temperatures and PSU output voltages where present, and interface traffic.
name: Router

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: System temperature of the GE MDS Orbit router in degrees Celsius, from mSysTemperature (MDS-SYSTEM-MIB, 1.3.6.1.4.1.4130.10.1.1.1.2.6.0). Values outside -60 to 150 are dropped.

metrics.name: mpr_heatsink1_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Heatsink #1 temperature of GE MDS Orbit MPR units in degrees Celsius, from mSysMprHeatsinkTemperature1 (1.3.6.1.4.1.4130.10.1.1.1.2.8.1.0). The object only exists on MPR units, so the series is absent on other models.

metrics.name: mpr_heatsink2_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Heatsink #2 temperature of GE MDS Orbit MPR units in degrees Celsius, from mSysMprHeatsinkTemperature2 (1.3.6.1.4.1.4130.10.1.1.1.2.8.2.0). Only present on MPR units.

metrics.name: device_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Power supply voltage of the GE MDS Orbit router in volts DC, parsed from the mSysPowerSupplyVoltage string (1.3.6.1.4.1.4130.10.1.1.1.2.9.0). Unparseable values and values outside 0 to 100 V are dropped.

metrics.name: mpr_psu1_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Output voltage of power supply #1 on GE MDS Orbit MPR units in volts, parsed from the mSysMprPowerSupplyVoltage1 string (1.3.6.1.4.1.4130.10.1.1.1.2.8.3.0). Only present on MPR units.

metrics.name: mpr_psu2_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Output voltage of power supply #2 on GE MDS Orbit MPR units in volts, parsed from the mSysMprPowerSupplyVoltage2 string (1.3.6.1.4.1.4130.10.1.1.1.2.8.4.0). Only present on MPR units.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
